maria (DevEx): Heads-up: Node 18->20 bump in ts-sdk landed in the beta branch and appears to change header parsing behavior for route metadata. Seen in canary logs. :grimacing:

sandeep (Eng-Platform): ugh — is this the same issue where `route-meta` becomes a buffer instead of string?

kai (Eng): yep. Node 20's fetch/polyfill returns headers iterators differently. Our route header parsing did `const raw = headers.get('x-rd-route'); JSON.parse(raw)` which breaks when `raw` is a `Uint8Array` in some runtimes.

maria (DevEx): Repro steps I used: set route hint in SDK, call local proxy, check request to internal routing API: shows `x-rd-route` serialized as `{"path":"/v1/foo"}` in 18, but `Uint8Array` in 20. I can paste logs if helpful.

kai (Eng): Paste would help. Also we need to know if this affects Python/Go clients (they use different HTTP libs).

maria (DevEx): Logs: ```
[canary] outgoing request headers: x-rd-route: Uint8Array(27) [123,34,112,97,116,104,34,58,34,47,118,49,47,102,111,111,34,125]
```

sandeep (Eng-Platform): That confirms. The internal routing proxy expects a JSON string. Our gateway accepts both, but console telemetry parsing downstream blows up when it tries to index into string.

tim (Eng-Console): We got >200 errors in the last 30m on the route-metrics pipeline. Stacktrace points to `JSON.parse(header)` failing with `TypeError: header.replace is not a function`.

lucy (Product): Impact? Are customer requests dropping or just internal metrics?

kai (Eng): Customers not dropping — the runtime fallback kicks in (model variant), but attribution/telemetry for those requests is lost and some dashboards show spikes in 'unknown-route'. Bad for SLO tracking.

maria (DevEx): Proposed immediate actions: 1) revert Node bump on main branch for ts-sdk beta, 2) ship small compatibility shim in SDK that normalizes header to string, 3) add end-to-end test (node20 + proxy) to CI. Thoughts?

sandeep (Eng-Platform): Agree on shim + E2E. Revert is heavy; prefer patch on SDK and a canary rollback if issues continue. Also need a console-side defensive parse: if non-string, try `new TextDecoder().decode(header)` before JSON.parse.

tim (Eng-Console): I'll add defensive decode in the telemetry ingestion path and a hotfix rule to map `unknown-route` back to raw route when possible. Can be deployed in ~2h.

kai (Eng): I'll open a PR with the shim and tests. Shim snippet: ```js
function normalizeRouteHeader(h) {
  if (!h) return null;
  if (typeof h === 'string') return h;
  if (h instanceof Uint8Array) return new TextDecoder().decode(h);
  if (Array.isArray(h)) return Buffer.from(h).toString();
  return String(h);
}
```

maria (DevEx): Nice. Also add release notes and an explicit compatibility section: "Node 20 consumers may need to upgrade to ts-sdk >= X.Y.Z or enable the compatibility shim." I'll draft.

lucy (Product): Let's schedule status update in the console release notes and ping any customers on Dedicated/private who run custom SDKs. We should avoid surprises.

sandeep (Eng-Platform): One more thing: add a telemetry tag `sdk.runtime` so we can roll back visually per SDK version during rollout. Makes it easy to correlate.

maria (DevEx): Good call. Kai, can you add `sdk.runtime` and `sdk.version` headers in the shim? Keep them optional.

kai (Eng): Yep. PR in a few mins. Will include unit tests for header normalization and an e2e job that runs node18+20 matrix.

release-bot: Deployed canary hotfix to telemetry-ingest v2.1.3-hotfix (tim). Monitoring: https://internal/infra/metrics/telemetry-ingest/alerts :eyes:

maria (DevEx): Thanks all. After PR merges we'll cut a patch for ts-sdk and coordinate a canary rollout. I'll update docs and ping support for customer notices. :thumbsup:

sandeep (Eng-Platform): Follow-ups: 1) add integration test for Python/Go runtimes to surface similar parity issues; 2) audit any code that assumes header is string (search repo). I'll take point on the audit.

lucy (Product): Good. Keep me posted before the public patch.

kai (Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/482 (includes shim + tests + header tags). PTAL.

maria (DevEx): Merged and cut 0.12.7-patch. Rolling canary to 1% traffic. Will follow with release blog blurb and docs entry.

tim (Eng-Console): Console dashboards already reflect drop in unknown-route after hotfix. Will keep watch.

maria (DevEx): Closing thread once metrics stable > 1h. Thanks everyone.
